results.name: Girl Doll Ramen (Eyes, Hair, Body Improvement)
results.description:
*All full-feature assets are available here [Patreon](https://www.patreon.com/chambersu) subscriptions can help me invest more in the artwork. You can also find some project files(.blend) on my Patreon for free. *

![](https://i.postimg.cc/LX5LRYx0/Snipaste-2023-11-06-17-40-58.png)

I applied the latest body, switched the AICG texturing hair and eyes to procedural shader, which seems more efficient and pretty. I will go on with clothing and mecha, then level and UI, and think about gameplay/coding and story in the meantime.

More tricks will be used after testing, which I will post when ready.

results.name: Ichiraku Ramen (Naruto)
results.description:
The legendary Ichiraku ramen shop from the Naruto Anime.

This was by far my most difficult model to date, and challenged all of my 3D art skills. The model is based almost entirely off of one blurry reference photo, so I had to improvise on the entire back end of the building.
10/10 do not recommend :D

results.name: Doll Ramen Clothing, Rig and NPR Shaders Preview
results.description:
[Purchase](https://skfb.ly/oNAt9) or Subscribe my [Patreon](https://www.patreon.com/chambersu) for project files, commercial use and general support.

![](https://i.postimg.cc/cCRF8Nyx/Snipaste-2023-11-12-22-27-28.png)

![](https://i.postimg.cc/Wz4bmY8F/mecha-T2-IRef.png)

- Clothing created in Marvelous Designer then retopologize and shade in Blender.
- Deformed-bones-only body rig for Cascadeur, and facial rig by Faceit.
- Rebuilt shaders from Unity URP Shader Graph to Blender nodes for preview. Then bake as emi maps for Sketchfab.

*Can find project files(.blend) on my [Patreon](https://www.patreon.com/chambersu). Subscriptions can help me create more for free under the Creative Commons license. 

*Also accept modeling commission. Feel free to contact me by leaving a comment or mailing to chambersu1996@gmail.com, if any questions or anything here interests you~

*Every like, comment, and subscription will support me to go further!
